mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.order_no, r.owner_id, o.owner_name, o.owner_phone, r.house_id, h.house_number, b.building_name, c.community_name, r.repair_type, r.repair_desc, r.repair_phone, r.priority, r.status, r.assignee_id, u.full_name as assignee_name, u.phone_number as assignee_phone, r.assign_time, r.repair_time, r.repair_cost, r.repair_result, r.evaluate_score, r.evaluate_comment, r.create_time, r.update_time FROM repair_order r LEFT JOIN owner_info o ON r.owner_id = o.id AND o.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN house_info h ON r.house_id = h.id AND h.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN building_info b ON h.building_id = b.id AND b.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN community_info c ON b.community_id = c.id AND c.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user_info u ON r.assignee_id = u.id AND u.is_deleted = 0 WHERE r.id = #{orderId} AND r.is_deleted = 0
